text:
Sasha: Heads-up — need a quick confirm from procurement/vendor on APAC demo rack for next Tue-Thu (May 14–16). Can vendor confirm 4x A100 (40GB) reserved in apac-east1? We have a canary load test.
Mike: @Sasha checking quota now, last I saw we had 2 reserved and 2 pending in the portal.
Lee: If vendor can't commit, we should plan to borrow 2x L40s from ephem pool. @Greg-oncall any objection?
vendor-bot: [vendor-updates] Reservation 12345: APAC staging - 2x A100 allocated, 2x A100 pending (ETA 48–72h). Link: https://vendor.example/alloc/12345
Tara: Procurement here — vendor told us backfill ETA ~ 2 days, but can escalate with PO. Do we have PO #?
Sasha: PO is PO-7832, sent last week. I'll attach invoice in the ticket.
Mike: Quick numbers: current quota (projects/redwood-staging): A100: quota 6, used 4, available 2. L40: quota 4, used 1, available 3.
Greg-oncall: Borrow OK from ephem for canary, but note preemptible risk. Plan: run short 60m smoke then offload.
Lee: For fallback plan — add this to the demo runbook:
```
if A100 not available:
  use L40 ephem
  set MAX_BATCH=4
  set TIMEOUT=60s
```
Sasha: Sounds good. @Tara can you try escalate with vendor support and cc @Mike?
Tara: On it, pinging vendor now.
vendor-bot: Support ticket #SUP-987 opened with vendor; engineer assigned.
Mike: Adding a quick terraform snippet to request extra quota — fyi
```
resource "vendor_quota_request" "apac_a100" {
  project = "redwood-staging"
  model = "a100"
  count = 2
}
```
Sasha: thanks — I'll update the demo schedule after vendor confirmation.
Greg-oncall: Also enabling telemetry alert if token latency > 300ms during canary.
Sasha: closing loop — will post final confirm here once vendor confirms or we borrow. :thumbsup:
